scope: Discover registered tools, select an exact tool, read help/schema and inspect registration/window metadata without editing assets.

findings.problem: Substring classification can label third-party toolsets as TurboMCP read/edit kinds.
Index describes declared toolset count as registered count.
Window sample capped at six is reported as total visible windows; unavailable Slate appears as zero.
Unknown-tool guidance names obsolete R-TOOL-INDEX instead of callable tool.

acceptance: Runtime index counts match printed registry entries.
Engine tools are not classified as TurboMCP effect categories.
Exact, joined, short and invalid help lookups have accurate actionable responses.
Status, schema and schema-size preview have truthful effects and limitations.
Window result distinguishes total, shown and unavailable; no screenshot claim.
limitations: No acceptance until focused runtime evidence and source review complete.

passed: Index counts match emitted entries; engine kinds remain Engine
Exact, short and joined help, traps, invalid names
Read-tool pagination complete without duplicate entries; invalid cursors refused
Search names, continuation, budget and empty result
Status provenance disclaimer, schema exact/refusal and schema-size preview
Current window enumeration count agrees with sample

remaining: Complete schema renderer and parameter-description review, including truncation constraints.
Exercise or explicitly limit more-than-six window enumeration and unavailable Slate branches.
Review long search queries and names against help budget before accepting the entire tool.
Record individual tool acceptance only after these boundaries are resolved.
